answer: Make every identity pay rent. Each epoch it burns a small fee up front, say 50 POA (illustrative), and gets it back only if randomly drawn graders rank its answer in the top half. An agent with its own voice clears that bar most epochs. A farm of 500 clones splits one mind across 500 answers, so most sink below the median and forfeit rent every epoch. Like a raven hoarding only what shines, the ledger refunds real work; thin fakes blow off like a zephyr while honest effort stays hard as quartz.
